policyCategories.mandatory: Required whenever the stated package or target condition applies.
policyCategories.conditional: Evaluate for the target governance configuration and installed features.

enablementPaths.direct: Set the environment toggle On and save.
enablementPaths.environmentGroup: Add the managed environment to a group with published rule 23, Power Apps code apps, configured On.

codeApps.verification: Run the read-only effective-state preflight and require powerApps_AllowCodeApps to be true for the exact environment ID before importing any package.

postImportRules.rule: Validate managed solution identity and version for every imported artifact from config/release-packages.json.
Create and map target-local physical connections before starting dependent flows; connection placeholder warnings do not make a successful import fail.
Set the target tenant value for the Credits environment variable when the optional Credits package is installed.
Keep packaged flows stopped until connection mappings, environment configuration, role assignment, and manual smoke validation pass.

criteria: Every selected managed package imports successfully, synchronously, and in the required core, optional Credits, optional code-app order.
scripts/validate_clean_install.py completes successfully against the target environment.

browserValidation.execution: Use one shared VS Code browser page and run hosted checks sequentially; never operate on one shared page in parallel.

criteria: Normal Power Apps launch does not return CodeAppOperationNotAllowedInEnvironment.
The exact runtime document returns successfully and delivers the packaged shell assets.
The parent-hosted authenticated app renders Sessions, Trends, Inventory, and Credits.
Authenticated connector and data behavior is validated through the parent Power Apps host.

directRuntime.rule: An exact powerplatformusercontent runtime URL may prove runtime document and asset delivery, but lacks the parent host token and must never be treated as authenticated connector or data smoke.

browserValidation.limitations: A shared-browser cross-origin iframe abort or hidden about:blank fullscreen host is a browser-validation limitation when reproduced against a known healthy app; it is not package-install failure evidence.

capture: Exact artifact filenames, versions, hashes, and synchronous import order
Preflight setting save and independent reload result
Read-only effective Code Apps setting result for the exact environment ID
Import warnings and final success state
Structural validator JSON, including component counts and target-generated app open URI
Hosted launch status, runtime document status, rendered views, and browser limitations
repositoryRules: Keep tenant IDs, environment IDs, temporary URLs, target-generated app IDs, hashes, and account names out of this committed contract.
Hand verified candidate evidence to the Release Maintainer; do not mutate stable artifacts or shipped history during candidate validation.

cleanup.rule: Always delete the disposable environment after evidence review, even when validation fails; cleanup remains owned by the coordinating release operator.

conditionalGovernance.topic: App quarantine, Conditional Access, tenant isolation, app access control, sharing limits, CSP, and IP restrictions
